p1: Work or study
Do you work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
Is there anything you would like to change about it?
Do you usually work or study better in the morning or in the evening?
Neighbours
Do you know your neighbours well?
How often do you talk to them?
Have your neighbours ever helped you with anything?

p2.card: Describe a time when you helped someone.
bul: and explain how you felt about helping this person
p2.vi: Hãy kể về một lần bạn đã giúp đỡ ai đó: bạn đã giúp ai, chuyện xảy ra khi nào và ở đâu, bạn đã làm gì để giúp, và giải thích bạn cảm thấy thế nào khi giúp người đó.

p3: Why are some people more willing to help strangers than others?
Do you think people in cities are less helpful than people in the countryside?
Should schools teach children to do volunteer work? Why or why not?
How has technology changed the way people help each other?

p1: Your hometown
Where is your hometown?
What is it best known for?
How has your hometown changed since you were a child?
Would you like to live there in the future?
Weather
What kind of weather do you like most?
Does the weather ever affect your mood?
What do people in your country usually do on rainy days?

p2.card: Describe a place in your city where you like to relax.
bul: and explain why it helps you relax
p2.vi: Hãy mô tả một nơi trong thành phố của bạn mà bạn thích đến để thư giãn: nơi đó ở đâu, bạn đến đó thường xuyên thế nào, bạn làm gì ở đó, và giải thích vì sao nơi đó giúp bạn thư giãn.

p3: Why do people in big cities find it hard to relax?
Should governments spend more money on parks and public spaces?
Do young people and older people relax in different ways?
Do you think people will have more or less free time in the future?

p1: Daily routine
What does a typical weekday look like for you?
Which part of the day do you enjoy most?
Has your routine changed much in the last few years?
Do you prefer a fixed routine or a flexible one?
Mobile phones
How much time do you spend on your phone each day?
What do you mostly use your phone for?
Could you live without your phone for a week?

p2.card: Describe a skill you learned from an older person.
bul: and explain how this skill has been useful to you
p2.vi: Hãy kể về một kỹ năng bạn học được từ một người lớn tuổi hơn: đó là kỹ năng gì, ai đã dạy bạn, bạn đã học nó như thế nào, và giải thích kỹ năng này đã hữu ích với bạn ra sao.

p3: What can young people learn from older generations?
Are traditional skills, such as cooking or handicrafts, disappearing in your country?
Is it better to learn practical skills from a person or from online videos?
Why do some older people find it difficult to learn new technology?

p1: Food and cooking
Do you enjoy cooking?
What did you usually eat for breakfast as a child?
Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
Is there any food you disliked as a child but enjoy now?
Music
What kind of music do you listen to?
Do you listen to music while you work or study?
Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?

p2.card: Describe a piece of advice you received that turned out to be useful.
bul: in what situation you received it
and explain why it was useful to you
p2.vi: Hãy kể về một lời khuyên bạn từng nhận được và hoá ra rất hữu ích: lời khuyên đó là gì, ai đã đưa ra, bạn nhận được nó trong hoàn cảnh nào, và giải thích vì sao nó hữu ích với bạn.

p3: Do people today ask their parents for advice less often than in the past?
Is advice from friends more reliable than advice from experts?
Why do some people ignore good advice?
Should people trust advice they find on social media?
